question: Can exact echoes of program-inherited watch questions be removed without changing any semantic decision, requirement or Candidate text?
rule: Remove a watch item only when its ID and complete object equal the inherited Plan item. Reject any same-ID difference; validate new items and every other Editor field under the original contract.
interpretation: A separate deterministic derivation after an observed format failure, not a rerun, semantic repair, behavioral validation, or retrospective change to comparison_incomplete. Keep the original raw calls and failure statuses.
